accessibility.evidence: Named native buttons and radio/input controls; stage title receives programmatic focus (checks.json); reduced-motion rule; primary controls >=44px. Body/secondary colors checked for contrast. This is a targeted check, not full VoiceOver/WCAG certification.

responsive.evidence: Home and lesson at six widths, checks.json: no horizontal overflow. Screenshot review of mobile/tablet/desktop and light/dark.

loading.evidence: MobileStatus displays cache progress until service worker ready; observed during initial capture.

empty.evidence: home-390.png has 0 completed and an explanation of when vocabulary appears.

error.evidence: quiz-error-390.png: wrong answer gives hint; browser test verifies second-error answer reveal.

partial.evidence: audio.spec.ts removes system speechSynthesis; bundled audio still plays offline.

success.evidence: quiz-success-390.png plus persisted completion and restore assertions in offline.spec.ts.

permission.evidence: Desktop browser test removes microphone access: Recorder explains unsupported capture and text alternative.

renderedEvidence.observation: Real built PWA with current lesson, explicit next action, review and persisted-progress area; checks.json confirms no horizontal overflow.
